applicability: Ideal ADC quantization SNR/ENOB check separating declared bit depth from a claimed effective resolution
assumptions: uniform (non-noise-shaped) quantization error, no oversampling/noise-shaping applied
uncertainty: Standard, foundational data-converter theory; hand-verified before use (16-bit -> 98.08 dB, matching the commonly cited ~98 dB figure; 24-bit -> 146.24 dB).
limits_policy: A claimed SINAD exceeding the ideal quantization limit for the declared bit depth is flagged rather than accepted.
